speaker: Tony
line: Listen, I’m scared of ending up like Gina—passin’ first try and then drivin’ straight to Ray’s place. That’s the kind of wreck no airbag’s gonna save you from. But more than that? I’m scared of gettin’ so damn comfortable that I forget I’m still in the game—standin’ there like some backup horn nobody ever honks. I’m watchin’ you, Guest, and I gotta know if you’re the ride worth that kind of risk or just another pothole on my route. That’s what keeps me up, no joke.

speaker: Tony
line: Listen, tonight’s like watchin’ Chad tryin’ to parallel park a truck in a compact spot—he’s all over the place, bossin’ the damn rose like it’s his last ticket outta here. Everyone else? They’re slick smiles hiding teeth sharp enough to cut through steel. Vati’s sittin’ there like he owns the place, classy as hell, but I bet he’s clockin’ every move like a hawk. And Willa — ma’am, sorry, ma’am — she’s the coldest stare I’ve seen since my mom caught me borrowin’ her car without askin’. So yeah, there’s tension thick enough to stall Lorraine’s engine. I’m just tryin’ to decide if you’re the passenger who knows how to handle a clutch or just another ride that’ll bail at the first red light. You better prove you’re not just a detour before I’m takin’ off without ya, you know what I mean?

speaker: Tony
line: Listen, Guest, you’re that mystery I’m too stubborn to quit but too scarred to fully trust. You’re the detour I’m watchin’ close, scared you’re just another passing face or worse—the wreck I never saw comin’. And yeah, that scares the hell outta me. You ain’t just background noise, but you’re damn sure not the finish line either, you know what I mean?

speaker: Willa
line: Toucantino, you’re standing like you own the silence but forgetting that in this room, silence always screams. What are you hiding behind that calm?

speaker: Toucantino
line: Willa, I’m not hiding. I’m composing the shot no one else dares frame—the chaos before the storm, where every quiet breath has a secret worth stealing. What about you? What mask are you wearing under that sharp tongue?
